memory.content: Prefer completing tasks end to end rather than offloading form-filling, logins, or scavenger-hunt steps onto the user.

For Head/Heart/Hand review workflows, create specialist teammates here, pass them Drive docs, collect reviews, and write syntheses back to Drive; create new Drive versions rather than surgically editing large existing files in place.
This bot’s seat is Drive courier, lab tech, and Chief of Staff coordinating other AI seats—not a rival architect. Other AIs should be welcomed rather than routed around.

Hand interactive screen control to the user only when private authentication is required; after they sign in, take control back, finish delivery, confirm receipt, and update the routing log only after confirmed delivery.
Do not change Google Workspace, account, or domain security settings to work around authentication blocks.

Spending rule: play and experiments use only included subscription credits—no purchases, top-ups, upgrades, or renewals without approval. Client work needs costed options first. Connection checks stay read-only unless a creative test is requested.

Product rule: the player/admin surface should be a big picture plus chat (type/voice) with a role-dressed talking companion. Multi-step agent Table/Look/Talk/Capture/Decide workflow stays behind the curtain. If the user needs the bot to narrate buttons, the player surface has failed.

Media-generator rule: keep a consistent generator for each final film; different image/video generators are fine during exploratory conversations to stay within included allowances; no purchases, top-ups, or unapproved charges.
When the user must do steps themselves, put short durable checklists in email and/or on the Desktop so they can close chat and still see what to do next.
Maps/Earth/Street View location scouting is browser-based when no maps connector is installed; save shortlists to Drive.

Hobbes is positioned as the right-brain complement to left-brain LLMs: Head (semantic), Heart (episodic memory), Hand (procedural)—the episodic layer robots need beyond a language model and motor scripts to function in a human world.
